steps.title: Sort cells into lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Sort single cells into 3 µL lysis‑buffer mix in each well, seal with seals rated for –80 °C to >100 °C, centrifuge at 2000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, snap‑freeze on dry ice and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw and spin plate
steps.instruction: Thaw the plate on ice, centrifuge at 500 × g, 4 °C for 5 min and keep the plate on ice.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to new plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 µL from each well of the sorted plate to an empty 384‑well plate using a low flow rate (2 mm/s) and an aspiration height of 0.9 mm above the bottom. (Eppendorf EpMotion 5073m used; Hamilton STARlet, Gilson Platemaster or manual 8‑channel pipettes are also compatible.)

steps.title: Spin down nuclear fraction
steps.instruction: Spin down the transferred plate and freeze the nuclear fraction at –20 °C to aid complete lysis. (If performing a DNA‑only protocol, spin down and snap‑freeze the cytosolic fraction on dry ice and store at –80 °C.)

steps.title: Prepare 2X Tn5 master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare 2X Tn5 buffer (final 10 mM TAPS, 5 mM MgCl₂, 8 % PEG‑8000) by mixing 1.6 µL 5X TAPS‑PEG (50 mM TAPS, 25 mM MgCl₂, 40 % PEG‑8000), 0.1 µL psfTn5 loaded with 50 µM MEDS‑A/B (equivalent to 0.122 µL in an 8 µL reaction) and 3.3 µL nuclease‑free H₂O per well (total 5 µL). Allow the viscous 5X TAPS‑PEG buffer to reach room temperature before dispensing, then vortex and spin down the plate.

steps.title: Tn5 tagmentation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 55 °C for 10 min, then add 2 µL per well of 0.2 % SDS, vortex, spin down and incubate a further 10 min at 55 °C.

steps.title: Pool tagmented material
steps.instruction: Pool 3 µL from each well into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: DNA library cleanup (first)
steps.instruction: Add 0.9 × volume SPRI beads prepared in 20 % PEG‑8000 to the pooled 300 µL, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on a magnetic rack for 3 min, remove supernatant, add 1 volume fresh 80 % EtOH, incubate 30 s, remove EtOH, repeat EtOH wash, air‑dry beads 10–15 min, resuspend in 100 µL EB or TE buffer, repeat the entire bead‑based cleanup and finally elute in 30 µL EB/TE.

steps.title: Optional DNA library QC
steps.instruction: Assess library size on an Agilent HS‑5000 DNA chip (or equivalent) and sequence on a NextSeq 550 at 2.5 pM (peak ~334 bp, paired‑end 37 bp + 8 bp dual index).

steps.title: Prepare RT master mix
steps.instruction: For each 384‑well reaction prepare 3 µL master mix containing: 0.05 µL Maxima H‑Minus RT (2 U/µL), 0.125 µL RNase inhibitor (40 U/µL), 1 µL 5X First‑Strand buffer, 0.25 µL 100 mM DTT, 1 µL 5 M betaine, 0.03 µL 1 M MgCl₂, 0.05 µL 100 µM TSO and 0.495 µL nuclease‑free H₂O. Dispense 3 µL per well, cover with a new film, spin down, then add 2 µL lysate to reach a 5 µL RT reaction.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Incubate at 42 °C for 1 h 30 min, then at 70 °C for 5 min, and hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA pre‑amplification mix
steps.instruction: For each well add 7 µL master mix consisting of 0.82 µL nuclease‑free H₂O, 6 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2X), 0.12 µL 10 µM IS_PCR primer, 0.06 µL Lambda exonuclease (10 U/µL). Then add 5 µL RT product to obtain a 12 µL reaction. Vortex, spin down, cover with a new lid.

steps.title: cDNA pre‑amplification PCR
steps.instruction: Run the following program: 37 °C 30 min (lambda exonuclease), 95 °C 3 min, then 18–24 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 67 °C 15 s, 72 °C 4 min, followed by 72 °C 5 min and hold at 4 °C. (Number of cycles should be optimized per cell type, e.g., by a pilot qPCR.)

steps.title: cDNA cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 × volume SPRI beads (20 % PEG) per well, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic stand for 3 min, remove supernatant, add 40 µL 80 % EtOH, incubate 30 s, remove EtOH, repeat EtOH wash, air‑dry beads 5–10 min (avoid over‑drying), elute in 12 µL EB or TE buffer, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic plate for 3 min, optionally remove supernatant. Store plates with beads at –20 °C if not proceeding immediately.

steps.title: Quantify cDNA (Qubit)
steps.instruction: Option 1 (96‑well plate): add 98.5 µL 1X Qubit HS dsDNA solution to each well of a flat‑bottom black plate, add 1.5 µL cDNA sample, add standards (0–10 ng/µL ladder), read fluorescence (485 nm excitation/528 nm emission) and calculate concentration. Option 2 (384‑well plate): add 20 µL 1X Qubit HS solution, add 1 µL cDNA, then proceed as above.

steps.title: Optional cDNA QC
steps.instruction: Assess cDNA size distribution on an Agilent HS‑5000 DNA chip (or equivalent).

steps.title: Normalize cDNA concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute each cDNA sample to a target of 150 pg/µL in a final volume of 15 µL (or adjust water volume per well in a 384‑well plate to achieve 150 pg/µL).

steps.title: Prepare Tn5 tagmentation master mix
steps.instruction: For each well dispense 1.5 µL master mix containing 0.75 µL nuclease‑free H₂O, 0.50 µL 5X TAPS‑PEG (10 mM TAPS, 5 mM MgCl₂, 8 % PEG), and 0.25 µL psfTn5 loaded with 50 µM MEDS‑A/B. Mix well and keep on ice.

steps.title: Add normalized cDNA to tagmentation
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL normalized cDNA (150 pg/µL) to each well containing the Tn5 master mix, vortex, cover with a new lid and spin down.

steps.title: Tn5 tagmentation (second)
steps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 10 min, then add 1 µL 0.1 % SDS per well, vortex, spin down and incubate a further 10 min at 55 °C.

steps.title: Prepare library PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each well dispense 8 µL master mix consisting of 4.85 µL nuclease‑free H₂O, 2.5 µL 5X KAPA HiFi buffer, 0.30 µL 10 mM dNTP mix (each dNTP), 0.20 µL KAPA HiFi enzyme (1 U/µL), and 0.15 µL 10 % Tween‑20 (final 0.12 %). Add this to the 3.5 µL tagmentation reaction (from step 20) to reach a total volume of 12.5 µL.

steps.title: Add indexing primers
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of primer mix (3.75 µM each forward and reverse primer from 384‑well index plates) to each well, giving a final primer concentration of 0.3 µM per primer. Vortex, spin down and cover.

steps.title: Library amplification PCR
steps.instruction: Run the following program: 72 °C 3 min, 95 °C 30 s, then 18 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 67 °C 30 s, 72 °C 45 s, followed by 72 °C 4 min and hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pool amplified libraries
steps.instruction: Pool 2.5 µL from each well into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Final library cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform SPRI‑bead cleanup as in step 7 (0.9 × volume beads in 20 % PEG, 5 min RT incubation, 3 min magnetic separation, EtOH washes, 10–15 min air‑dry, resuspend in 100 µL EB/TE, repeat cleanup and elute in 30 µL EB/TE).

steps.title: Final library QC
steps.instruction: Assess the pooled library of 784 cells on an Agilent HS‑D5000 TapeStation (or equivalent).
